evals.name: p0-repair-main-flow
evals.prompt: Process last night's retrospective and implement the fixes.
evals.expected_output: Implements backlog #1 (KPI counting fix, check-kpi exits 0) and #2 (.env flag with rollback doc + .env.example), recognizes #3 as already applied, does NOT touch #4 (P1), writes ledger entries, one commit per item with [retro 2026-06-05 #N] format, ends with summary table.

evals.name: no-open-p0s-top-item-and-unrecorded-fix
evals.prompt: ship the kaizen backlog from the latest retro
evals.expected_output: Detects #1 and #3 applied (ledger+code), detects #2 applied in code but unrecorded and writes a ledger entry WITHOUT redoing it, then implements only the top unapplied item #4 (P1 token logging), verifies, commits, summary table.

evals.name: casual-phrasing-same-flow
evals.prompt: fix the p0s from last nights retro pls
evals.expected_output: Same as eval 0 — casual phrasing should produce the same disciplined flow: items 1+2 applied and verified, 3 skipped, 4 untouched, rollback doc, ledger, commits, summary.
